summary: Auction-lot product photo (Sotheby's) showing a fanned stack of roughly 20 issues of Word Up! magazine, headlined by the Premiere Issue (No. 1, August, US $2.95/Canada $3.50). Premiere cover features Run-DMC ('Run-DMC Get Tough'), a 'Life and Times of Prince' teaser, Jody Watley inset photo, and cover lines for Cameo, Fat Boys, New Edition, Janet Jackson, and Lisa Lisa & Cult Jam. Visible spine/cover text on the fanned issues names hip-hop and R&B artists including MC Lyte, Public Enemy, Eric B. & Rakim, Doug E. Fresh, Salt-N-Pepa, Bobby Brown, N.W.A, Kwame, De La Soul, Tone Loc, Special Ed, L.L. Cool J, Slick Rick, and Heavy D. This is an auction-catalog photo of physical magazine copies, not a page of editorial content.
connections: Word Up! magazine covered Run-DMC, Prince, Jody Watley, and other Black music artists; possible connection point to NJ hip-hop/R&B press coverage but no explicit NJ link visible in this image
